verdict.rationale: Databricks documents a no-cost Free Edition workspace for exploring datasets and experimenting with data and AI, plus a free trial account. Its getting-started docs walk through querying sample data in Unity Catalog, which covers self-serve evaluation without a sales call. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that no credit card is required, documentation of Free Edition limits on querying your own (real) data at meaningful scale, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the signup and evaluation experience.
